marks_correction.headline: The carried marks were not merely stale — one was wrong by 18.4%.
marks_correction.bafs_finding: The 9.80 BAFS mark did not correspond to 2026-08-04 at all. The real 2026-08-04 close was 10.80. BAFS last traded at 9.80 around 2026-02-23/26 and again near 9.75 on 2026-06-17 — so the carried mark was months out of date while being labelled four days old. BAFS then rose steadily through June and July (8.75 on 2026-05-29 to 11.60 on 2026-08-07, +32.6%) and the entire move was invisible to this system.
marks_correction.root_cause_class: Same family as avg_cost_price = 0 and the unwritten dividend store: a value that is absent or unverified renders downstream as a normal number. Here a mark of unknown vintage was given a specific recent date, which made it unfalsifiable.
marks_correction.process_rule_added: A carried mark must carry the date it was OBSERVED, never the date it was copied. If the observation date is unknown, the mark is unknown.

delta_interpretation: This delta is a CORRECTION, not a return. It measures the gap between what the book was worth and what this system said it was worth. Tho did not make THB 41,160 on 2026-08-07; he had already made most of it over June and July and was not told.
weights_caveat: Now derived from real 2026-08-07 closes rather than carried marks. Still EXCLUDES the gold sleeve, which remains unvalued for want of a unit count, so these overstate each equity's share of Tho's true book.
concentration_note: All three positions breach the 30% single-name threshold, and the book is now almost exactly equal thirds (33.27 / 32.87 / 33.86). 100% Thailand, 100% SET, and within it two energy-complex names. The rebalancer has flagged this for several runs; the corrected weights make the flag more accurate, not less severe.

BAFS_H1_2026.trap_identified: Buddhist-era year labelling. 2568 = 2025, 2569 = 2026. Thai-language financial sources use BE by default and a one-year slip reads as a plausible current result.
